findings.title: The logic for checking team admin/owner permissions is incorrect. This condition uses AND (&&) which requires both isTea
findings.description: The logic for checking team admin/owner permissions is incorrect. This condition uses AND (&&) which requires both isTeamAdmin AND isTeamOwner to be true, but it should use OR (||) since a user needs to be either an admin OR an owner to have permission.

findings.title: This calls the email sender with the original guests, so existing attendees included in the input will be treated as new
findings.description: This calls the email sender with the original guests, so existing attendees included in the input will be treated as new when sending notifications, leading to incorrect emails.

findings.title: uniqueGuests filters out existing attendees and blacklisted emails but does not deduplicate duplicates within the input;
findings.description: uniqueGuests filters out existing attendees and blacklisted emails but does not deduplicate duplicates within the input; createMany can insert duplicate attendee rows if the client submits repeated emails.
